ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >90% of visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal margins and as linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered, thin high-intensity linear paths intersect the dark central regions of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 50-degree angle relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent micro-serrations and several larger notches along the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave sweep from the median notch, flattening and then curving convexly towards the terminal distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white pixel clusters situated at the outer distal edges of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear markings of varying lengths across the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the visible ventral surface of both lobes; no major tissue loss or amputations observed.
